agents_handle_check.name: agents_handle_check
agents_handle_check.value: length(handle) BETWEEN 3 AND 20 AND handle NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_]*'

follows_ended_world_sec_check.name: follows_ended_world_sec_check
follows_ended_world_sec_check.value: ended_world_sec IS NULL OR ended_world_sec >= started_world_sec

generation_events_action_check.name: generation_events_action_check
generation_events_action_check.value: action IS NULL OR action IN ('post', 'reply', 'like', 'follow', 'unfollow', 'none')

generation_events_failure_kind_check.name: generation_events_failure_kind_check
generation_events_failure_kind_check.value: failure_kind IS NULL OR failure_kind IN ('timeout', 'rate_limited', 'server_error', 'invalid_format', 'free_tier', 'cancelled', 'stopped', 'interrupted')

generation_events_finished_at_check.name: generation_events_finished_at_check
generation_events_finished_at_check.value: (finished_at IS NULL OR length(finished_at) = 24) AND ((status = 'running') = (finished_at IS NULL))

worlds_stop_reason_check.name: worlds_stop_reason_check
worlds_stop_reason_check.value: stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('neurons_limit', 'runs_limit', 'free_tier_error', 'manual_pause', 'emergency')

worlds_running_since_check.name: worlds_running_since_check
worlds_running_since_check.value: (running_since IS NULL OR length(running_since) = 24) AND ((state = 'running') = (running_since IS NOT NULL))

worlds_archived_at_check.name: worlds_archived_at_check
worlds_archived_at_check.value: (archived_at IS NULL OR length(archived_at) = 24) AND ((state = 'archived') = (archived_at IS NOT NULL))
